name: 2123 S. Indiana Avenue — the livery stable at 2123-2125, its wagon shed on 2123 (district draft; refined by T-1946)

function.note: The 1911 sheet reads 'A livery (LIVERY, crossed): a 2-storey frame wagon shed and one-storey frame range on 2123, joined to a 3-storey brick livery stable 80 ft long on 2125, from Indiana Avenue to the alley'.  Carried to 1904 on the T-3009 census ruling (present_as_mapped).

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3009, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1946 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 35w trace (s35wfp-indiana_2123-b1), the T-3009 census (s35w-2123-front) and the T-1837 register row frontage-35w-2123–2125; every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-district-background-3009).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-3009 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 3.750, v -7.250 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Rotation 179.125 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'service' overlaid with the frontage row: A livery the sheet draws from Indiana Avenue to the alley: the brick stable and the frame wagon shed joined, drafted as one service building at the trace's outline under a gable, its height the service rules'. A horse-age use, carried to 1904 as one. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 1016588935 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
